summary: NovaGold Resources filed an 8-K updating its July 22, 2026 plan of arrangement under the BC Business Corporations Act, in which newly formed Delaware entity New NovaGold will acquire all outstanding NovaGold shares. Terms are a one-for-one share exchange, with Paulson contributing its 40% Donlin Gold LLC stake for New NovaGold voting and non-voting stock, voting capped at 19.99%, valued at a 10% discount to NovaGold's 10-day VWAP as of July 21, 2026. No price, premium, break fee, or close date was stated. Watch shareholder and court approvals plus Donlin funding milestones.
